title.zh: Morning Minute: Clarity Act Odds Soar as Trump Agrees to Ethics Provisions
title.en: Morning Minute: Clarity Act Odds Soar as Trump Agrees to Ethics Provisions

current_state.zh: Odds of the Clarity Act passing jumped to 31% after Trump agreed to ethics provisions, ahead of a Tuesday Senate vote on crypto market structure legislation, as crypto majors rebounded with BTC at $77.7k.
current_state.en: Odds of the Clarity Act passing jumped to 31% after Trump agreed to ethics provisions, ahead of a Tuesday Senate vote on crypto market structure legislation, as crypto majors rebounded with BTC at $77.7k.
